plan: Keep queueing jungle as primary — it is already Xeebs's usual queue AND best role at 53.8% over 364 games (overall is 50.4%).
Stop queueing carry: 42.8% over 201 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Khaimera. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Xeebs wins about 5.9 more games per 100 on it.
Xeebs's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 40% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Xeebs is at 307 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Khaimera is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 205 games and Xeebs genuinely out-pilots the field on Khaimera — about 5.9 more wins per 100 games than the average Khaimera player. The hours show.

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 brings out Xeebs's best
insights.finding: Xeebs's record alongside Mr_Meat31 is 54% over 311 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.
